config.esad.zoomMode.tooltip:
Hold: zooms while the key is held down.
Toggle: each key press switches the zoom on or off.
config.esad.zoomLevel.tooltip: How far you zoom in when you press the key.
config.esad.scrollZoom.tooltip: Use the scroll wheel to zoom further in or out while zooming. The hotbar slot does not change meanwhile.
config.esad.scrollStep.tooltip: Each scroll step multiplies or divides the zoom by this value.
config.esad.retainScrollZoom.tooltip: Keeps the zoom level you scrolled to for the next zoom instead of going back to the zoom level.
config.esad.zoomInTime.tooltip: Length of the zoom in animation. 0 zooms in instantly.
config.esad.zoomOutTime.tooltip: Length of the zoom out animation. 0 zooms out instantly.
config.esad.smoothScroll.tooltip: Animates zoom changes from the scroll wheel instead of jumping.
config.esad.relativeSensitivity.tooltip: Lowers the mouse sensitivity the further you zoom in. 100% keeps aiming feeling the same at every zoom level, 0% keeps the normal sensitivity.
config.esad.cinematicCamera.tooltip: Smooths the camera movement while zooming, like the vanilla cinematic camera.
config.esad.hideHand.tooltip: Hides your hand and held item while zooming.
config.esad.dynamicLightsEnabled.tooltip: Held torches, dropped light items, burning and glowing entities light up the blocks around them. Only visual, mobs still spawn in the dark.
config.esad.dynamicLightsUpdateRate.tool: How often moving lights are updated. Every update rebuilds the chunks around them, slower rates help on weak PCs.
config.esad.dynamicLightsRange.tooltip: Only light sources this close to you are used.
config.esad.dynamicLightsSelf.tooltip: Light from items you hold yourself.
config.esad.dynamicLightsHeldItems.toolt: Players and mobs holding a light source, e.g. a torch.
config.esad.dynamicLightsEntities.toolti: Blazes, magma cubes, glow squids, fireballs, primed TNT, spectral arrows and creepers about to explode.
Torches, campfires, lava buckets and similar items give no light under water.
config.esad.tooltipShiftHint.tooltip: Shows "Hold Shift for more info" when an info is only visible with Shift.
config.esad.tooltipDurability.tooltip: Durability of tools, weapons and armor.
config.esad.tooltipDurabilityColor.toolt: Color of the numbers, bar or text. Varying is green, gold or red depending on the remaining durability.
config.esad.tooltipDurabilityWhenFull.to: Also shows the durability of items that are not damaged yet.
config.esad.tooltipFood.tooltip: Hunger points and saturation of food.
config.esad.tooltipFuel.tooltip: How long a fuel burns in a furnace and how many items it smelts.
config.esad.tooltipRepairCost.tooltip: The levels an anvil adds for previous repairs and enchantments.
config.esad.tooltipEnchantments.tooltip: A short explanation below every enchantment.
config.esad.tooltipModName.tooltip: Which mod the item comes from. Not shown when Mod Menu is installed, it adds the name itself.
config.esad.tooltipItemId.tooltip: The id of the item, e.g. minecraft:diamond_sword.
config.esad.tooltipMap.tooltip: Shows filled maps as a small picture.
tooltip.esad.durability.label: Durability:
enchantment.minecraft.aqua_affinity.esad: Mines at normal speed under water.
enchantment.minecraft.bane_of_arthropods: More damage to spiders, bees, silverfish and endermites.
enchantment.minecraft.binding_curse.esad: Can't be taken off until it breaks or you die.
enchantment.minecraft.blast_protection.e: Less damage and knockback from explosions.
enchantment.minecraft.breach.esad_desc: Ignores part of the target's armor.
enchantment.minecraft.channeling.esad_de: Thrown trident summons lightning during thunderstorms.
enchantment.minecraft.density.esad_desc: More damage the further you fall before the hit.
enchantment.minecraft.fire_protection.es: Less fire damage and shorter burning.
enchantment.minecraft.flame.esad_desc: Arrows set the target on fire.
enchantment.minecraft.fortune.esad_desc: More drops from ores and some blocks.
enchantment.minecraft.frost_walker.esad_: Freezes water under you into ice.
enchantment.minecraft.luck_of_the_sea.es: Better chance for treasure when fishing.
enchantment.minecraft.lunge.esad_desc: Jab attacks with the spear push you forward.
enchantment.minecraft.punch.esad_desc: Arrows knock the target further back.
enchantment.minecraft.riptide.esad_desc: Throwing the trident in water or rain launches you.
enchantment.minecraft.soul_speed.esad_de: Walk faster on soul sand and soul soil.
message.esad.day_counter.debug_enabled: §a[Day Counter] §fDebug mode §aenabled§f. Day output started in the console.
message.esad.day_counter.help_position: §e/dc position §f- Move the HUD with the mouse.
message.esad.day_counter.help_debug: §e/dc debug §f- Toggle debug output in the console.
config.esad.dayCounterToggleKey.tooltip: Shows or hides the day counter in game.
config.esad.dayCounterPosition.tooltip: Drag the counter to where you want it. It stays in place when you resize the window.
config.esad.dayCounterCustomText.tooltip: {day} is replaced with the day, {time} with the in-game time.
config.esad.dayCounterDebug.tooltip: Writes the day, time and position to the log every 5 seconds.
config.esad.pingTabList: Ping as text in tab list
config.esad.pingTabList.tooltip: Off shows the vanilla signal bars again.
config.esad.pingUnknownText.tooltip: Shown while the server has not sent a ping yet.
config.esad.pingColorMode.tooltip: Steps: one color per range. Gradient: the color slowly changes from one range to the next.
config.esad.pingRanges.description: Everything at or above the last value counts as terrible.
esad.screen.title: EssentialAdditions
esad.description: Small quality of life features in one mod: zoom, dynamic lights, advanced tooltips, a day counter and a ping display. Every feature can be turned on and off on its own.
esad.screen.reset.tooltip: Resets every setting of the selected feature to its default. Nothing is saved until you press Save.
esad.screen.switch.on: On, click to turn it off
esad.screen.switch.off: Off, click to turn it on
esad.feature.zoom.description: Zoom in with a key, with smooth animation and scroll wheel zoom.
esad.feature.dynamicLights.description: Held torches, dropped light items and burning mobs light up their surroundings.
esad.feature.tooltips.description: Extra item info: durability, food values, burn time, enchantment descriptions and more.
esad.feature.dayCounter.description: Shows the current Minecraft day on screen.
esad.feature.pingDisplay.description: The ping as colored number in the tab list and on name tags.
esad.feature.fullbright.description: See everything clearly in the dark, like with night vision. Toggled with a key.
config.esad.fullbrightStrength.tooltip: 100% is as bright as the night vision effect.
config.esad.fullbrightMessage.tooltip: Shows "Fullbright: On / Off" above the hotbar.
esad.feature.infoHud.description: Coordinates, facing, biome, FPS, ping and more in a movable box.
config.esad.infoHudDecimals.tooltip: Shows the exact position with one decimal instead of the block position.
config.esad.infoHudOtherDimension.toolti: In the Overworld the matching Nether coordinates (divided by 8), in the Nether the matching Overworld coordinates.
config.esad.infoHudLight.tooltip: Block light and sky light at your feet. Mobs spawn at block light 0.
config.esad.infoHudClock.tooltip: The real time of your computer.
config.esad.infoHudPosition.tooltip: Drag the element to where you want it. It stays in place when you resize the window.
esad.feature.armorHud.description: Your armor and held items with their durability, with a warning when something is about to break.
config.esad.armorHudHands.tooltip: Also shows the items in your main hand and off hand.
config.esad.armorHudItemCount.tooltip: For held items without durability (blocks, arrows, food), shows how many of them you have in your whole inventory.
config.esad.armorHudWarningPercent.toolt: Items with less durability left are shown in red. 0% turns the warning off.
config.esad.armorHudWarningText.tooltip: Shows a blinking "Low durability!" above the HUD.
config.esad.armorHudPosition.tooltip: Drag the element to where you want it. It stays in place when you resize the window.
esad.feature.effectsHud.description: Your status effects as a list with name, level and remaining time.
config.esad.effectsHudNames.tooltip: Name and level of the effect, e.g. "Speed II".
config.esad.effectsHudCategoryColors.too: Good effects in green, bad effects in red.
config.esad.effectsHudBlinkSeconds.toolt: The icon blinks during the last seconds of an effect. 0 turns blinking off.
config.esad.effectsHudHideVanilla.toolti: Hides the effect icons at the top right of the screen, they would show the same.
config.esad.effectsHudPosition.tooltip: Drag the element to where you want it. It stays in place when you resize the window.
esad.feature.keystrokes.description: Shows the movement keys, jump and mouse buttons you press, with clicks per second.
config.esad.keystrokesCps.tooltip: Shows the clicks of the last second on the mouse buttons instead of LMB / RMB.
config.esad.keystrokesPosition.tooltip: Drag the element to where you want it. It stays in place when you resize the window.
esad.feature.toggleSprint.description: Keys that keep you sprinting or sneaking until you press them again, with a status text.
config.esad.toggleSprintKey.tooltip: Unbound by default. One press starts sprinting, the next one stops it.
config.esad.toggleSneakKey.tooltip: Unbound by default. One press starts sneaking, the next one stops it.
config.esad.toggleSprintAlways.tooltip: Sprints whenever you walk forward, no key needed.
config.esad.toggleSprintRemember.tooltip: Keeps the toggled states when you leave the world or restart the game.
config.esad.toggleSprintHudVanilla.toolt: Shows the status also while you hold the vanilla keys.
config.esad.toggleSprintHudPosition.tool: Drag the element to where you want it. It stays in place when you resize the window.
esad.feature.sleepReminder.description: Tells you when you can sleep and warns you before phantoms come.
config.esad.sleepReminderNight.tooltip: A message when the night starts and beds can be used.
config.esad.sleepReminderThunder.tooltip: Beds can also be used during a thunderstorm at day.
config.esad.sleepReminderPhantoms.toolti: Warns when you did not sleep for several nights. The nights are counted while the game runs, the server does not tell the client its own counter.
config.esad.sleepReminderPhantomNights.t: Phantoms spawn after 3 nights without sleep in vanilla.
config.esad.sleepReminderChat.tooltip: Shows the reminder in the chat instead of above the hotbar.
message.esad.sleep.night: It's night, you can sleep now.
message.esad.sleep.phantoms: You haven't slept for %s nights, phantoms can come!
esad.feature.pickupNotifier.description: Shows "+12 Coal" when you pick up items.
config.esad.pickupNotifierRarityColors.t: Colors the text like the item name, e.g. enchanted books in yellow.
config.esad.pickupNotifierTotal.tooltip: Also shows how many of the item you have now, e.g. "+12 Coal (76)".
config.esad.pickupNotifierPosition.toolt: Drag the element to where you want it. It stays in place when you resize the window.
config.esad.tooltipContainer.tooltip: Shows the content of shulker boxes and other filled containers as an inventory grid.
config.esad.tooltipContainerColor.toolti: Tints the slots in the color of the shulker box.
config.esad.tooltipContainerHideList.too: Hides the vanilla list of the content while the preview is shown.
config.esad.tooltipEnderChest.tooltip: Shows the content of your ender chest on ender chest items. The game only knows it after you opened your ender chest once.
config.esad.tooltipTool.tooltip: Mining speed (also with Efficiency) and the mining level of tools.
tooltip.esad.ender_chest.unknown: Open your ender chest once to see its content here
esad.feature.blockOutline.description: Own color, transparency and thickness for the outline of the block you look at.
config.esad.blockOutlineColor.tooltip: Color and transparency of the outline. Vanilla is black with 40% opacity.
config.esad.blockOutlineRainbow.tooltip: Cycles through all colors, the transparency of the color above stays.
esad.feature.chat.description: Timestamps, a longer chat history and repeated messages stacked into one line.
config.esad.chatTimestamps.tooltip: Shows the time of every message in front of it, e.g. "[14:32]".
config.esad.chatHistory.tooltip: How many messages the chat keeps for scrolling up. Vanilla keeps 100.
config.esad.chatStack.tooltip: The same message several times in a row is shown once with "(x3)" behind it.
esad.feature.freelook.description: Look around freely with a key while you keep walking in the same direction.
config.esad.freelookMode.tooltip:
Hold: look around while the key is held down.
Toggle: each key press switches freelook on or off.
config.esad.freelookThirdPerson.tooltip: Switches to third person while looking around, so you can see yourself. Back to first person afterwards.
esad.feature.inventorySort.description: Sorts your inventory or a chest with a key or a middle click.
config.esad.inventorySortKey.tooltip: Press it in any inventory screen. Sorts the inventory or container under the mouse.
config.esad.inventorySortMiddleClick.too: A middle click on a slot sorts its inventory. Not in creative mode, where middle click copies items.
config.esad.inventorySortOrder.name: By name
config.esad.inventorySortHotbar.tooltip: Off keeps your hotbar as it is when sorting your own inventory.
config.esad.inventorySortMerge.tooltip: Fills stacks that are not full with items of the same kind first.
